rules.title: Prohibition of housing discrimination and protected characteristics
rules.requirement: Landlords and housing owners are prohibited from discriminating against or harassing any person in housing accommodations based on race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.

rules.title: Prohibition of income standard discrimination against cohabitants
rules.requirement: Housing providers must account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as married persons when applying financial or income standards.

coverage.summary: Applies to rentals of housing utilizing financial or income standards for cohabitants.

rules.quoted_span: To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons residing together or proposing to reside together.

rules.title: Alternative evidence of ability to pay for government rent-subsidized housing
rules.requirement: When a government rent subsidy is present, housing providers cannot use income standards not based on the tenant's portion of rent, and must offer applicants with subsidies the option to provide verifiable alternative evidence of ability to pay in lieu of credit history.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing applications involving government rent subsidies.
coverage.unresolvable: Requires presence of government rent subsidy.

rules.quoted_span: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant. (B) (i) Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant, including, but not limited to, government benefit payments, pay records, and bank statements.
